worldcombat.skill.tailslap.summary: Spin in place and sweep the hard tail around the body lap after lap: everyone in the ring takes a hit and is shoved outward. The spin form is a full 360 degrees that covers every side; the smash form narrows to the front arc, hits each lap harder and lifts the target.
worldcombat.skill.tailslap.use.0: Spin in place and sweep the tail around everyone nearby
worldcombat.skill.tailslap.use.1: Cover a whole ring when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.tailslap.use.2: Smash form sweeps only the front and lifts what it hits
worldcombat.skill.tailslap.description.0: Each lap is %1$s power (Attack and weight), up to %2$s laps per pass, each at %3$s accuracy; a missed lap deals no damage but the spin continues.
worldcombat.skill.tailslap.description.1: Sweep radius %1$s blocks, arc %2$s degrees, targets are shoved %3$s blocks and lifted %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.tailslap.smash.on: Smash form: sweeps only the front ~200 degrees, each lap x1.25 power and x1.4 lift, focusing the damage on one side; the cost is x0.8 shove and +1 tick between laps.
worldcombat.skill.tailslap.smash.off: Spin form: a full 360 degrees with a stronger shove, covering everyone at once; the cost is a slightly lighter lap.
worldcombat.skill.tailslap.timing: Radius %1$s blocks, prepare %2$s, recover %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.tailslap.growth.0: At level %1$s, each lap rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.tailslap.growth.1: At level %1$s, each lap %2$s and sweep radius %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.tailslap.growth.2: At level %1$s, each lap %2$s and shove %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.tailslap.preference.sm: On (smash): each lap x1.25 power and x1.4 lift, focusing the damage and lifting the target; the cost is sweeping only the front ~200 degrees (x0.55 arc), x0.8 shove and +1 tick between laps. Off (spin, native): a full 360 degrees with a stronger shove, covering everyone at once; the cost is a slightly lighter lap.
worldcombat.skill.tailslap.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first instead of starting the spin.
On: opens the spin more readily when other enemies stand near the target, since the full ring catches several at once; off: ranks only by the ordinary melee order.
On: under a hold order it will still leave its post to spin; off: only casts when the target is already in range.
